paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 8a according to Dikdukei Soferim, where he addresses Rav Bivi bar Abaye as “my teacher.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Eruvin 8a names Rabbah bar Ulla (רבה), addressing Rav Bivi bar Abaye as רבי, “my teacher.” Hyman reports Ravin from Dikdukei Soferim; the name forms are kept distinct.

The whole selected Davidson Eruvin 8a paragraph has Rabbah bar Ulla addressing Rav Bivi bar Abaye as רבי. Hyman’s Ravin/Dikdukei Soferim report stays separate and the existing note remains verbatim. My teacher renders the address, without a fresh apparatus collation or teacher-identity admission.
